scope: 63 capability definitions; actual per-record coverage exported separately.

completion_rate.limitation: Coverage conditional on saved result/State; missing run result never excluded from planned completion denominator.
completion_rate.definition: Completed cases / all selected cases; absent result remains incomplete.

strict_accept_rate.limitation: Coverage conditional on saved result/State; missing run result never excluded from planned completion denominator.
strict_accept_rate.definition: Accepted cases / all cases selected for the named acceptance contract.
strict_accept_rate.aggregation: sum(accepted) / eligible selected cases; not_evaluated is null, not false

candidate_recall.limitation: Captured boundaries; unknown semantics need review. GT approval pending.
candidate_recall.definition: GT cases with a matching root cause in the first raw candidate response / eligible GT cases.
candidate_recall.aggregation: micro case recall; no final-state backfill

admitted_candidate_recall.limitation: Captured boundaries; unknown semantics need review. GT approval pending.
admitted_candidate_recall.definition: GT cases with a correct initially admitted candidate / eligible GT cases.
admitted_candidate_recall.aggregation: micro case recall; distinct from initial raw recall

competition_survival.limitation: Captured boundaries; unknown semantics need review. GT approval pending.
competition_survival.definition: GT cases retaining a matching candidate at competition / eligible GT cases. Conditional retention uses a separately named report, never changes this denominator.
competition_survival.aggregation: micro case rate; missing upstream capture is unknown, not eliminated

ranking_survival.limitation: Captured boundaries; unknown semantics need review. GT approval pending.
ranking_survival.definition: GT cases retaining a matching candidate at ranking / eligible GT cases. Conditional retention uses a separately named report, never changes this denominator.
ranking_survival.aggregation: micro case rate; missing upstream capture is unknown, not eliminated

confirmation_survival.limitation: Captured boundaries; unknown semantics need review. GT approval pending.
confirmation_survival.definition: GT cases retaining a matching candidate at confirmation / eligible GT cases. Conditional retention uses a separately named report, never changes this denominator.
confirmation_survival.aggregation: micro case rate; missing upstream capture is unknown, not eliminated

supported_root_cause_recall.source: final authority + external GT adjudication; legacy scorer has related but different status metrics
supported_root_cause_recall.limitation: Final authority exists; legacy exact-string/substring scorer lacks reviewed canonical identity/scope/time mapping. No trusted automated hit yet.
supported_root_cause_recall.definition: Distinct correct supported GT roots / GT roots that should be supported.
supported_root_cause_recall.aggregation: micro root-level TP / eligible GT roots

root_cause_hit_rate.limitation: Final authority exists; legacy exact-string/substring scorer lacks reviewed canonical identity/scope/time mapping. No trusted automated hit yet.
root_cause_hit_rate.definition: Cases whose final published root cause matches GT / all cases with identifiable GT root.
root_cause_hit_rate.aggregation: micro case hit rate; completion/strict/supported alone are not a match

first_pass_json_success_rate.limitation: Observed operation lineage only; requires complete dedicated-thread capture.
first_pass_json_success_rate.definition: JSON successes on initial output attempt with no caller retry / all logical model calls (requested call-based denominator).
first_pass_json_success_rate.aggregation: sum(initial successful JSON calls) / all logical calls; transport failures included

json_decode_success_rate.limitation: Requires complete capture + no dropped/orphan events; existing runner may lose outer telemetry on unhandled exception.
json_decode_success_rate.definition: Successful JSON object decodes / logical calls; includes valid repaired responses.
json_decode_success_rate.aggregation: successful JSON calls / all logical calls

first_attempt_operation_success_rate.limitation: Observed operation lineage only; requires complete dedicated-thread capture.
first_attempt_operation_success_rate.definition: Operations whose first logical call decodes JSON / all model operations; companion metric resolving operation-vs-call ambiguity.
first_attempt_operation_success_rate.aggregation: successful first calls / operation count; do not substitute for call-based KPI

json_decode_failure_rate.limitation: Requires complete capture + no dropped/orphan events; existing runner may lose outer telemetry on unhandled exception.
json_decode_failure_rate.definition: Invalid JSON/object decode calls / calls reaching content decoder
json_decode_failure_rate.aggregation: sum raw failed/valid items / sum eligible items; no counting error strings as items

dto_validation_failure_rate.limitation: Lists and opt-in rejection facts exist, but all attempted-item/reference denominators and all-stage taxonomy are incomplete. Message count is not failed-item count.
dto_validation_failure_rate.definition: Rejected DTO items / attempted DTO items
dto_validation_failure_rate.aggregation: sum raw failed/valid items / sum eligible items; no counting error strings as items

business_validation_failure_rate.source: existing caller validators and Planner diagnostics
business_validation_failure_rate.limitation: Lists and opt-in rejection facts exist, but all attempted-item/reference denominators and all-stage taxonomy are incomplete. Message count is not failed-item count.
business_validation_failure_rate.definition: Rejected business validation attempts / attempted business validations
business_validation_failure_rate.aggregation: sum raw failed/valid items / sum eligible items; no counting error strings as items

semantic_validation_error_rate.limitation: Lists and opt-in rejection facts exist, but all attempted-item/reference denominators and all-stage taxonomy are incomplete. Message count is not failed-item count.
semantic_validation_error_rate.definition: Rejected semantic profile items / attempted profile items
semantic_validation_error_rate.aggregation: sum raw failed/valid items / sum eligible items; no counting error strings as items

candidate_validation_error_rate.limitation: Lists and opt-in rejection facts exist, but all attempted-item/reference denominators and all-stage taxonomy are incomplete. Message count is not failed-item count.
candidate_validation_error_rate.definition: Rejected candidate items / attempted candidate items
candidate_validation_error_rate.aggregation: sum raw failed/valid items / sum eligible items; no counting error strings as items

invalid_reference_rate.limitation: Lists and opt-in rejection facts exist, but all attempted-item/reference denominators and all-stage taxonomy are incomplete. Message count is not failed-item count.
invalid_reference_rate.definition: Invalid reference occurrences / all submitted reference occurrences
invalid_reference_rate.aggregation: sum raw failed/valid items / sum eligible items; no counting error strings as items

valid_evidence_reference_rate.limitation: Lists and opt-in rejection facts exist, but all attempted-item/reference denominators and all-stage taxonomy are incomplete. Message count is not failed-item count.
valid_evidence_reference_rate.definition: Valid Evidence reference occurrences / all submitted Evidence reference occurrences
valid_evidence_reference_rate.aggregation: sum raw failed/valid items / sum eligible items; no counting error strings as items

invalid_evidence_reference_rate.limitation: Lists and opt-in rejection facts exist, but all attempted-item/reference denominators and all-stage taxonomy are incomplete. Message count is not failed-item count.
invalid_evidence_reference_rate.definition: Invalid Evidence reference occurrences / all submitted Evidence reference occurrences
invalid_evidence_reference_rate.aggregation: sum raw failed/valid items / sum eligible items; no counting error strings as items

isolated_bad_candidate_rate.source: generator candidate isolation; not all raw items persisted
isolated_bad_candidate_rate.limitation: Lists and opt-in rejection facts exist, but all attempted-item/reference denominators and all-stage taxonomy are incomplete. Message count is not failed-item count.
isolated_bad_candidate_rate.definition: Rejected-and-isolated raw candidate items / attempted raw candidate items
isolated_bad_candidate_rate.aggregation: sum raw failed/valid items / sum eligible items; no counting error strings as items

provider_failure_rate.limitation: Coverage conditional on saved result/State; missing run result never excluded from planned completion denominator.
provider_failure_rate.definition: Cases with at least one recorded provider failure / selected cases
provider_failure_rate.aggregation: sum numerator / eligible denominator; stage breakdown retains same unit

fallback_rate.limitation: Challenge attempts now exact; other caller counters/fallback flags are not a complete per-operation ledger. Count real calls, not planned repair or messages.
fallback_rate.definition: Cases with any stage fallback / selected cases
fallback_rate.aggregation: sum numerator / eligible denominator; stage breakdown retains same unit

timeout_rate.limitation: Use HTTP event timeout, not Qwen terminal generic transport_error; rates require observed eligible denominator.
timeout_rate.definition: Timeout logical calls / all logical calls
timeout_rate.aggregation: sum numerator / eligible denominator; stage breakdown retains same unit

rate_limit_rate.limitation: Use HTTP event timeout, not Qwen terminal generic transport_error; rates require observed eligible denominator.
rate_limit_rate.definition: Rate-limited HTTP attempts / all HTTP attempts
rate_limit_rate.aggregation: sum numerator / eligible denominator; stage breakdown retains same unit

invalid_response_rate.limitation: Use HTTP event timeout, not Qwen terminal generic transport_error; rates require observed eligible denominator.
invalid_response_rate.definition: Invalid provider envelope responses / HTTP responses received
invalid_response_rate.aggregation: sum numerator / eligible denominator; stage breakdown retains same unit

context_overflow_rate.limitation: DeepSeek category + Challenge preflight facts exist; Qwen HTTP error normalization and preflight denominator are not uniformly complete.
context_overflow_rate.definition: Context-overflow logical calls / all logical calls
context_overflow_rate.aggregation: sum numerator / eligible denominator; stage breakdown retains same unit

unsupported_capability_rate.source: future configuration preflight; has no model call
unsupported_capability_rate.limitation: Capability checks exist before model calls, but no universal persisted preflight outcome ledger.
unsupported_capability_rate.definition: Rejected workflow capability preflights / attempted preflights
unsupported_capability_rate.aggregation: sum numerator / eligible denominator; stage breakdown retains same unit

logical_llm_calls.limitation: Requires complete capture + no dropped/orphan events; existing runner may lose outer telemetry on unhandled exception.
logical_llm_calls.definition: Calls delegated after cap admission, including failures; cap rejection is not a provider call
logical_llm_calls.aggregation: per-case count; aggregate sum; never infer attempts from usage rows

http_attempts.limitation: Requires complete capture + no dropped/orphan events; existing runner may lose outer telemetry on unhandled exception.
http_attempts.definition: Actual client.post attempts; successful retries currently absent
http_attempts.aggregation: per-case count; aggregate sum; never infer attempts from usage rows

caller_retries.limitation: Observed operation lineage only; requires complete dedicated-thread capture.
caller_retries.definition: Additional logical calls caused by transient call retry
caller_retries.aggregation: per-case count; aggregate sum; never infer attempts from usage rows

output_repairs.limitation: Observed initial/repair/retry lineage; unobserved paths remain unknown.
output_repairs.definition: Additional logical calls made after prior output validation failure
output_repairs.aggregation: per-case count; aggregate sum; never infer attempts from usage rows

action_count.limitation: Coverage conditional on saved result/State; missing run result never excluded from planned completion denominator.
action_count.aggregation: per-case count; aggregate sum; never infer attempts from usage rows

tool_count.limitation: Coverage conditional on saved result/State; missing run result never excluded from planned completion denominator.
tool_count.definition: Actual tool invocations including failed invocations
tool_count.aggregation: per-case count; aggregate sum; never infer attempts from usage rows

evidence_count.limitation: Coverage conditional on saved result/State; missing run result never excluded from planned completion denominator.
evidence_count.definition: Typed Evidence records in final case State
evidence_count.aggregation: per-case count; aggregate sum; never infer attempts from usage rows

logical_llm_calls_per_case.limitation: Requires complete capture + no dropped/orphan events; existing runner may lose outer telemetry on unhandled exception.
logical_llm_calls_per_case.definition: Calls delegated after cap admission, including failures; cap rejection is not a provider call / selected cases.
logical_llm_calls_per_case.aggregation: sum observed case counts / observed cases; report coverage against all selected cases

http_attempts_per_case.limitation: Requires complete capture + no dropped/orphan events; existing runner may lose outer telemetry on unhandled exception.
http_attempts_per_case.definition: Actual client.post attempts; successful retries currently absent / selected cases.
http_attempts_per_case.aggregation: sum observed case counts / observed cases; report coverage against all selected cases

caller_retries_per_case.limitation: Observed operation lineage only; requires complete dedicated-thread capture.
caller_retries_per_case.definition: Additional logical calls caused by transient call retry / selected cases.
caller_retries_per_case.aggregation: sum observed case counts / observed cases; report coverage against all selected cases

output_repairs_per_case.limitation: Observed initial/repair/retry lineage; unobserved paths remain unknown.
output_repairs_per_case.definition: Additional logical calls made after prior output validation failure / selected cases.
output_repairs_per_case.aggregation: sum observed case counts / observed cases; report coverage against all selected cases

action_count_per_case.limitation: Coverage conditional on saved result/State; missing run result never excluded from planned completion denominator.
action_count_per_case.definition: Executed action records per case / selected cases.
action_count_per_case.aggregation: sum observed case counts / observed cases; report coverage against all selected cases

tool_count_per_case.limitation: Coverage conditional on saved result/State; missing run result never excluded from planned completion denominator.
tool_count_per_case.definition: Actual tool invocations including failed invocations / selected cases.
tool_count_per_case.aggregation: sum observed case counts / observed cases; report coverage against all selected cases

evidence_count_per_case.limitation: Coverage conditional on saved result/State; missing run result never excluded from planned completion denominator.
evidence_count_per_case.definition: Typed Evidence records in final case State / selected cases.
evidence_count_per_case.aggregation: sum observed case counts / observed cases; report coverage against all selected cases

http_attempts_per_logical_call.limitation: Requires complete capture + no dropped/orphan events; existing runner may lose outer telemetry on unhandled exception.
http_attempts_per_logical_call.aggregation: sum attempts / sum logical calls; zero calls => not_applicable

input_tokens.limitation: Reliable when reported; missing/failed response usage is unknown, cache/reasoning presence flags not complete. Legacy zero-fill forbidden.
input_tokens.definition: Provider-reported input_tokens; missing usage is unknown, never assumed free.
input_tokens.aggregation: sum reported tokens; failed zero-filled legacy events mark coverage partial

input_tokens_per_case.limitation: Reliable when reported; missing/failed response usage is unknown, cache/reasoning presence flags not complete. Legacy zero-fill forbidden.
input_tokens_per_case.aggregation: sum tokens / cases with token coverage; expose missing cases

output_tokens.limitation: Reliable when reported; missing/failed response usage is unknown, cache/reasoning presence flags not complete. Legacy zero-fill forbidden.
output_tokens.definition: Provider-reported output_tokens; missing usage is unknown, never assumed free.
output_tokens.aggregation: sum reported tokens; failed zero-filled legacy events mark coverage partial

output_tokens_per_case.limitation: Reliable when reported; missing/failed response usage is unknown, cache/reasoning presence flags not complete. Legacy zero-fill forbidden.
output_tokens_per_case.aggregation: sum tokens / cases with token coverage; expose missing cases

total_tokens.limitation: Reliable when reported; missing/failed response usage is unknown, cache/reasoning presence flags not complete. Legacy zero-fill forbidden.
total_tokens.definition: Provider-reported total_tokens; missing usage is unknown, never assumed free.
total_tokens.aggregation: sum reported tokens; failed zero-filled legacy events mark coverage partial

total_tokens_per_case.limitation: Reliable when reported; missing/failed response usage is unknown, cache/reasoning presence flags not complete. Legacy zero-fill forbidden.
total_tokens_per_case.aggregation: sum tokens / cases with token coverage; expose missing cases

cost.limitation: Rates frozen; incomplete cache/tariff gives bounds; missing usage gives null.
cost.definition: Total priced call cost including cached/reasoning/billable retry usage where applicable.
cost.aggregation: same currency/pricing validity; incomplete usage => partial/null; zero successful denominator => not_applicable

cost_per_case.limitation: Rates frozen; incomplete cache/tariff gives bounds; missing usage gives null.
cost_per_case.definition: Total priced cost / selected cases with complete cost coverage.
cost_per_case.aggregation: same currency/pricing validity; incomplete usage => partial/null; zero successful denominator => not_applicable

cost_per_successful_rca.limitation: Rates frozen; incomplete cache/tariff gives bounds; missing usage gives null.
cost_per_successful_rca.definition: Total experiment cost / cases externally scored as final correct and supported; includes failed-case costs in numerator.
cost_per_successful_rca.aggregation: same currency/pricing validity; incomplete usage => partial/null; zero successful denominator => not_applicable

cost_per_logical_call.limitation: Rates frozen; incomplete cache/tariff gives bounds; missing usage gives null.
cost_per_logical_call.definition: Total priced cost / admitted logical calls with complete cost coverage.
cost_per_logical_call.aggregation: same currency/pricing validity; incomplete usage => partial/null; zero successful denominator => not_applicable

call_latency_min.limitation: Use complete ledgers, failure coverage, n and cohort. Call latency differs from HTTP latency; suppress P95 for small Pilot.
call_latency_min.definition: min observed call latency; sample count always retained.
call_latency_min.aggregation: min/max as named; median/p50 linear interpolation; p95 linear interpolation h=(n-1)*0.95; n=1 all quantiles equal, no reliability claim; missing failures reported
